title: Working Moms in Real Estate - RE Investing, Airbnb Wins & Summer Travel Tips
description:
🎙️ WORKING MOMS 

In this fun and insightful episode of Working Moms, we dive into the world of real estate investing, Airbnb strategies, summer travel in Texas, and one beauty tip that literally brightens your eyes in seconds!

👯‍♀️ Gloria and Marisa are back with laughter, life hacks, and lots of relatable stories about juggling motherhood, business, and a splash of Texas summer fun. From navigating tax protests to accidental paddleboard adventures, this one’s full of real-talk and real resources!

✨ In This Episode:

Gloria’s favorite way to invest in real estate
Understanding Texas tax protests + homestead caps simplified
What is house hacking and how it helps build wealth fast 💰
Airbnb wins in Temple and Georgetown, TX — and why they’re booked out!
A must-have beauty drop (Lumify) that makes your eyes pop in under 2 minutes 👁️💄
Favorite summer spots in Texas:
🌊 South Padre Island
🌸 Fredericksburg
🛶 Lady Bird Lake (Austin)
🏞️ Wimberley
🎣 Port Aransas
🧠 Bonus tips for planning family trips, managing chaos, and summer mom hacks!

🧡 Whether you're a working mom, entrepreneur, investor, or just along for the ride — we’ve got something for you in this episode!
